professionalOverview.title: Professional Overview
professionalOverview.author: Viswanath Vasa
paragraphs: I'm Viswanath (Visu), a CS student at UMD focused on cybersecurity and networking. I build full-stack apps, IoT systems, and the security layers around them. Right now I'm co-founder and CTO at SenseGuard, where we monitor industrial sites with low-power sensors.
Questions about a project? Email me or find me on LinkedIn and GitHub.

technicalApproach.title: Technical Approach
technicalApproach.author: Viswanath Vasa
paragraphs: Security-first development doesn't mean sacrificing speed or innovation. I implement "Shift Left" security practices, integrating vulnerability analysis and threat modeling from day one. This proactive approach has consistently reduced security incidents by over 90% across projects I've led.

My technical stack emphasizes both performance and protection: React and Next.js for responsive frontends, Node.js and TypeScript for type-safe backends, and automated CI/CD pipelines for reliable deployments. I architect systems that scale efficiently while maintaining strict security standards, including SenseGuard's long battery life and reliable uptime.

featured.title: SenseGuard, Inc.
description: SenseGuard monitors industrial sites with low-power IoT sensors and a full-stack dashboard. Operators get alerts when something looks wrong, without babysitting every device.

Containerized backend services using Docker and deployed to Google Cloud Platform, supporting CI/CD workflows and maintaining 99.9% service availability. Configured and provisioned 200+ IoT sensors and gateways across 50+ sites, validating end-to-end data pipelines and standardizing device onboarding procedures.
